'''Blueberries''' are an [[aboveground]] [[crop|garden vegetable]]. They can be planted in all seasons, the fruit is edible raw or [[cooking|cooked]], and can also be [[brewing|brewed]] into [[alcohol|blueberry wine]].

Blueberries grow in [[tundra]] environments.

Some [[Dwarf|dwarves]] [[preferences|like]] blueberry bushes for their ''fruit''.


[[File:PattsBlueberries.jpg|thumb|center|300px|Admired for its ''fruit''.]]

== Color ==

{{D for Dwarf}}

Do not say that blueberries are blue, those suckers are purple. Truly blue food is kept by [[nobles]] from the rest of the dwarves because it probably bestows immortality.
